caseName: Capital National Bank v. Board of Supervisors
caseNameFull: Capital National Bank v. Board of Supervisors of Hinds County and Same v. City of Jackson
attorneys: Mr. B. H. Thompson for petitioner., Messrs. Wm. H. Watkins and P. H. Eager, Jr., for respondents.

opinions.text: The petitions for writs of certiorari in these cases are severally denied, upon the ground that the judgments sought here to be reviewed are joint and the records fail to disclose summons and severance. Hartford Accident & Indemnity Co. v. Bunn, 285 U. S. 169; § 237 (b), Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of February 13, 1925 (43 Stat. 936, 937).
